kebab_example: aliyun xtee describe-event-log-page --lang zh --reg-id cn-hangzhou --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --begin-time 1737101348000 --end-time 1746669075000 --req-id-pbs BD6B08EC-1B44-5378-8838-C76A36415C55 --service-abs de_afghcf6411 --account-id-prp 180650758xxxxxxx --nick-name-prp '测试xx' --mobile-prp 17600000000 --email-prp xxxx@123.com --ip-prp 168.168.168.168 --user-name-type-lrp type --login-type-lrp PASSWORD --register-ip-prp 168.168.168.168 --login-result-arp SUCCESS --fail-reason-lrp wrongPassword --user-agent-prp 00-1C-F0-1D-A7-81 --refer-prp refer --umid-pdi '设备ID' --mac-prp 00-1C-F0-1D-A7-81 --device-type-lrp PC --operate-source-lrp PC --tags-lbs rg0001 --score-sbs 1 --score-ebs 2 --condition-1-al rm0102 --condition-2-al rm0102 --condition-3-al rm0102 --api-version 2021-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeEventLogPage

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The region code
parameters.name: reg_id

parameters.help_en: The current page number
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp of the log. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 日志开始的时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The request ID
parameters.name: req_id_pbs

parameters.help_en: The event name (instance_id)
parameters.name: service_abs

parameters.help_en: The account ID (request_param.accountId). The value can be up to 50 characters in length and supports the "*" and "?" wildcards
parameters.help_zh: 账户ID(request_param.accountId)不超过50个字符，支持“*”、“？”通配符
parameters.name: account_id_prp

parameters.help_en: The account nickname (request_param.nickName). The value can be up to 50 characters in length and supports the "*" and "?" wildcards
parameters.help_zh: 账户昵称(request_param.nickName)不超过50个字符，支持“*”、“？”通配符
parameters.name: nick_name_prp

parameters.help_en: The phone number (supports MD5: request_param.mobile/request_param.mobileMd5). The value can be up to 30 characters in length and supports the "*" and "?" wildcards. The search is performed based on the mobile and mobileMd5 fields
parameters.help_zh: 手机号(支持MD5request_param.mobile/request_param.mobileMd5)，不超过30个字符，支持“*”、“？”通配符，按照字段mobile、mobileMd5两个字符进行搜索
parameters.name: mobile_prp

parameters.help_en: The email address (request_param.email). The value can be up to 100 characters in length and supports the "*" and "?" wildcards
parameters.name: email_prp

parameters.help_en: The IP address (request_param.ip). The value can be up to 20 characters in length and supports the "*" and "?" wildcards
parameters.help_zh: IP(request_param.ip)不超过20个字符，支持“*”、“？”通配符
parameters.name: ip_prp

parameters.help_en: The account name type for the logon scenario (-request_param.userNameType)
parameters.name: user_name_type_lrp

parameters.help_en: The logon authentication method (-request_param.loginType)
parameters.name: login_type_lrp

parameters.help_en: The account registration IP address (request_param.registerIp). The value can be up to 20 characters in length and supports the "*" and "?" wildcards
parameters.help_zh: 账户注册IP(request_param.registerIp)，不超过20个字符，支持“*”、“？”通配符
parameters.name: register_ip_prp

parameters.help_en: The logon success flag (request_param.loginResult)
parameters.name: login_result_arp

parameters.help_en: The logon failure reason (-request_param.failReason)
parameters.name: fail_reason_lrp

parameters.help_en: The user agent (-request_param.userAgent). The value can be up to 50 characters in length and supports the "*" and "?" wildcards
parameters.name: user_agent_prp

parameters.help_en: The referer (-request_param.refer). The value can be up to 50 characters in length and supports the "*" and "?" wildcards
parameters.name: refer_prp

parameters.help_en: The device ID (device_info.umid)
parameters.name: umid_pdi

parameters.help_en: The device MAC address (-request_param.mac). The value can be up to 30 characters in length and supports the "*" and "?" wildcards
parameters.help_zh: 设备MAC地址(-request_param.mac)，不超过30个字符，支持“*”、“？”通配符
parameters.name: mac_prp

parameters.help_en: The device type (request_param.deviceType). Example values: 1: PC. 2: MOBILE
parameters.name: device_type_lrp

parameters.help_en: The operation source (request_param.operateSource). Example values: 1: PC. 2: H5. 3: App
parameters.name: operate_source_lrp

parameters.help_en: The risk label (tags). The data is obtained from DescribeTagsList
parameters.name: tags_lbs

parameters.help_en: The start value of the score range (score). Only non-negative integers are allowed. The end value must be greater than the start value. Both boundaries are inclusive
parameters.help_zh: 分值区间起始值(score)，只能输入非负整数，右区间必须大于左区间，左右区间都取闭合
parameters.name: score_sbs

parameters.help_en: The end value of the score range (score). Only non-negative integers are allowed. The end value must be greater than the start value. Both boundaries are inclusive
parameters.help_zh: 分值区间终止值(score)，只能输入非负整数，右区间必须大于左区间，左右区间都取闭合
parameters.name: score_ebs

parameters.help_en: The first full-text match condition. The value can be up to 30 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 全文匹配1，不能超过30个字符
parameters.name: condition_1_al

parameters.help_en: The second full-text match condition. The value can be up to 30 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 全文匹配2，不能超过30个字符
parameters.name: condition_2_al

parameters.help_en: The third full-text match condition. The value can be up to 30 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 全文匹配3，不能超过30个字符
parameters.name: condition_3_al

pageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
